completedTasks.title: Long-query FTS OR joins capped at 64 distinct content words (ADR-0126); release 1.56.1
completedTasks.summary: A 7,259-char memory_search query OR-joined 968 raw tokens (stopwords + repeats, uncapped) and took 74 s on a 22,450-entry bank; clients cancelled at 8-15 s. FtsQueryNormalizer now keeps the verbatim OR at <=64 raw tokens (every gate query unchanged) and above that drops stopwords/repeats and keeps the first 64 distinct terms, in both the long-query primary and the <=4-content-word OR fallback (review BLOCKING). Measured ~0.3 s at 7k chars, ~0.1 s at 60k; dedup alone still 6.4 s. Cap is SearchDefaults.MaxKeywordTerms (Core), read by QueryLengthGuard's warning. ADR-0126 supersedes ADR-0072's dedup/cap rejections on cost only; quality findings stand.

completedTasks.title: Context key total over a NULL project id; stored vec-trigger bodies replaced (ADR-0124, 1.53.13)
completedTasks.summary: vec0's metadata ctx rejects NULL, while MemorySql.ContextKeyExpression returned SQL NULL for project_id IS NULL (its C# twin never did): the vec_entries_au/vec_structure_au triggers threw at MarkEmbedded (ADR-0119 charged 3 attempts then abandoned the row), the v9 rebuild's rethrow blocked opening a v2-v8 bank holding such a row, and pre-v9 partition keys accepted the NULL. Fix: COALESCE(project_id,'') in every concatenating branch (key total: project:/custom:0::L/workspace:0::W, equal to ContextKeyFor(_, '')) plus an every-open probe-first replacement of the two stored trigger bodies from shared constants (EnsureVecCtxTriggerBodiesAsync, ADR-0023 amendment shape) — CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS cannot replace an existing bank's body, and the live bank's bodies carried the old expression. stillTrue: dotnet_env=local must be set per-directory for the DeployToLocalSource build target to push to .nupkg-local

Transport is the --transport flag (stdio|http|https|proxy), default proxy since ADR-0020. MCP_TRANSPORT and AIRACCOON_DATA_ROOT do NOT exist - ServerConfig records that the env layer was removed by the single-channel ruling, and McpServerFactory injects the data root via WebApplicationFactory.UseSetting, not the environment
sqlite-memory's content-hash dedup is global — cross-context duplicates need preserve_duplicate_paths=1 + distinct logical paths
Dapper 2.1.79 parameter binding is case-sensitive against SQL param names and its record ctor matching chokes on nullable params — alias columns and use a settable DTO
sqlite-memory/vector/sync are native SQLite extensions loaded via Microsoft.Data.Sqlite LoadExtension; deferred embeddings (defer_embeddings=1) let writes work before any model is configured
MCP protocol CallToolResult.IsError is null on success (absent), true only on failure — assert ShouldNotBe(true), not ShouldBe(false)
Bare `ai-raccoon` is a proxy: it opens no bank, resolves no key and loads no ONNX model. `--transport stdio` is the in-process server and the escape hatch when a backend cannot start

`serve` mints <data-root>/mcp-token (0600) BEFORE it binds, so a port that answers guarantees the file exists; the probe accepts 401 as proof of a live server so it still recognises one across data roots

/mcp and /shutdown accept the loopback token in either envelope: X-AiRaccoon-Token or Authorization: Bearer *** one credential compared with FixedTimeEquals on both paths and neither shadowing the other. /mcp alone renders a second 401 body for a credential that was presented but did not match; /shutdown keeps one body for every failure because ADR-0022 pins the refusal not to reveal whether a token exists. `serve --mcp-entry` prints a headers map carrying ${AIRACCOON_MCP_TOKEN}, never a live token - Hermes resolves it from ~/.hermes/.env, Claude Code from the environment, and an unset variable in Claude Code warns in `claude mcp list` but still sends the literal placeholder.

The manifest is the budget source of truth: chunkTokens (1022) sets memory chunk size AND the query-trim budget; code chunks stay 510 (min(510, ctx-2)). Everything that says 'longer than one chunk' or pins the manifest must follow it — scripts/src/bundle.py's BUNDLED_MANIFEST pin (guarded by scripts/tests/test_bundle.py::test_committed_files_match_their_pins) and every chunk-count fixture derive from the manifest, never literals.

ChunkBudgetReconciler (EntryEmbedder drain, after vec reconcile, before the embed loop): re-chunks AND re-embeds at the resolved budget; embedding.chunkBudget stamp present iff the last run converged; unproven note groups get 3 passes per resolved budget then stop gating (residual population named in ADR-0125); terminal skips never gate; event 448 reports counts.

Long-blocking tool calls in delegated lanes kill the session ('aborted (lost)' — observed 3x at dotnet-test full-suite launches; the dotnet-engineer persona's sonnet/bedrock pin also has no API key and falls back to openrouter). Lane briefs must mandate detached runs + tail polling and commit-as-you-go.
